review_scope: Current generated array type declaration semantics, per-object complete operational metadata with type and schema effective usage; not whole pg_type raw tuple audit or full program code line audit.
provider_query: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,t.typname AS name,format_type(t.oid,NULL) AS sql_type,en.nspname AS element_schema,e.typname AS element_name,e.typtype AS element_kind,COALESCE(c.relkind::text,'-') AS element_relkind,t.typinput::regproc::text AS input_proc,t.typoutput::regproc::text AS output_proc,t.typreceive::regproc::text AS receive_proc,t.typsend::regproc::text AS send_proc,t.typdelim,t.typndims,t.typnotnull,t.typlen,t.typbyval,t.typalign,t.typstorage,pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner) AS owner,t.typacl::text AS acl,has_type_privilege('anon',t.oid,'USAGE') AS anon_usage,has_type_privilege('authenticated',t.oid,'USAGE') AS member_usage,has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') AS anon_schema_usage,has_schema_privilege('authenticated',n.oid,'USAGE') AS member_schema_usage,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute at JOIN pg_class cr ON cr.oid=at.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=cr.relnamespace WHERE at.atttypid=t.oid AND at.attnum>0 AND NOT at.attisdropped AND ns.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND ns.nspname<>'information_schema') AS direct_col_uses,md5(row_to_json(t)::text) AS catalog_row_md5 FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace JOIN pg_type e ON e.oid=t.typelem JOIN pg_namespace en ON en.oid=e.typnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=e.typrelid WHERE t.typtype='b' AND t.typcategory='A' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema' ORDER BY n.nspname,t.typname
observations: All arrays generated by PostgreSQL from named element types, not optional duplicate app objects.
One identified subscriber filter array used in two Realtime columns; absence of direct field use for remaining arrays is not deletion proof.
Effective type USAGE alone never proves table SELECT, an RLS bypass, or API schema exposure.
No production or member row read, production write, source code fix, or deployment.
